sections.subhead: One Clear View of Your Business Data, Pulled From Everywhere It Lives

body.text: A business dashboard is a single screen that pulls data from your CRM, ERP, spreadsheets or databases and shows the key numbers your team needs to make decisions. Teknoppy, a web application development company in Kochi, builds custom dashboards around the decisions you make, not around the data you happen to have.
We agree the handful of metrics that matter first, then map where that data lives, before designing any chart.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Dashboard Development in Kochi

items.html: We build around decisions, not just data. A dashboard should answer specific questions your team asks regularly — we design backward from those questions, not forward from available data.

Zero per-user licensing fees. Unlike Power BI or Tableau that charge steep recurring monthly per-seat licenses for every single employee who views a report, custom dashboards built by Teknoppy have no viewer licensing costs.
Multi-source data integration. We connect CRMs, ERPs, SQL databases, IoT feeds and spreadsheets into one coherent view, keeping numbers updated automatically.
Actionable two-way dashboards. Beyond static charts, we can build direct action triggers — like approving requests, updating statuses, or exporting customized reports.

sections.h2: Dashboard Development in Kochi: Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What is a custom business dashboard?
items.a: A custom business dashboard is a web application that connects to your databases, CRMs, ERPs, and spreadsheets to present real-time key performance indicators (KPIs), charts, and actionable metrics in a single, unified interface.

items.q: How is a custom dashboard different from Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio?
items.a: Off-the-shelf BI tools require expensive monthly per-seat licenses for every single viewer, have rigid UI constraints, and cannot easily trigger operational workflows. A custom web dashboard has zero viewer licensing fees, matches your brand, embeds into your staff portal, and allows two-way actions like updating records or triggering alerts.

items.q: Can the dashboard pull data from multiple disconnected systems?
items.a: Yes. We integrate APIs and database connectors to pull and harmonize data from CRMs, ERPs, Google Sheets, SQL databases, and third-party accounting tools into one unified view.

items.q: Will our dashboard update in real time?
items.a: Yes, where it matters. We configure live WebSocket or scheduled polling feeds for operational metrics (like live support queues or daily sales) and daily/weekly snapshots for high-level executive summaries.

items.q: How do you handle user permissions and data access?
items.a: We build role-based access control (RBAC), ensuring department managers only see their branch or team numbers, while executive leaders see aggregated company-wide metrics.

items.q: How much does custom dashboard development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Cost depends on the number of data connectors, refresh rate requirements, and custom visualization features. We review your data sources and deliver a fixed-price proposal within 24 hours.
